capabilities: Escape Markdown trigger characters while typing
Escape pasted text with the same rules
Repair current notes or the entire vault
Clean up over-escaped tags, emphasis and frontmatter
Back up notes before repair and restore backups
extras: Escaping adds backslashes to raw note source; works only in edit mode; vault-wide repair scans backup folders; raw HTML requires turning protection off.
problem: Markdown gives C++ characters such as <, [, *, _, == and #include a second meaning, so notes break, links vanish and directives become tags.

relations.evidence: add Yaki-Blake/Cpp-Input-Guard as a beta plugin via BRAT

summary: Input guard that escapes Markdown trigger characters in C++ notes while typing or pasting and repairs existing notes.
